_howTo: Fill in what genshin-db 5.2.14 is missing (#73). Copy the text exactly as the game shows it.
talent: which talent the text belongs to: combat1 (Normal Attack), combat2 (Skill), combat3 (Burst), passive1-4, or c1-c6. A slot that replaces genshin-db's text for that talent uses the same key.
If a character got a brand-new effect rather than a changed talent, use the talent it is listed under in game.
source: where and when you copied it, e.g. 'in-game 7.1, 2026-10-10'. Add more slots to a character if more than one talent changed.
npm run kit reads filled slots in place of genshin-db and lists the empty ones.
